ns2:course.label: Internship in Education Policy, Organization and Leadership
ns2:course.description: Supervised direct experience in the administration of higher education. With the aid of the faculty, students select the internship relevant to their career goals. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 8 hours; no more than 8 hours may be earned toward an advanced degree. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
